results.content:
Consumer confidence fell in August as expectations for the future business and labor market conditions became more pessimistic, a monthly survey from The Conference Board said.

The research group said its consumer confidence index fell in August to 89.4 from 90.2 in July. Economists polled by The Wall Street Journal had expected a higher reading of 90.2.
